|lore=Human-replica droid. Programmed to function as Xizor’s personal bodyguard and assassin. Black Sun agent. Cost 9 million credits. Worth every decicred.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. At Coruscant sites where you have a Black Sun Agent, your Force drains are +1. While with Xizor in battle, she may be forfeited to satisfy all remaining battle damage against you. Immune to Restraining Bolt, purchase, and attrition < 5.

|notes=The Players Committee released Set 7 on 16 July 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946id_/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. The remaster raises deploy to 4, drops the protection against reducing forfeit and the added battle destiny with Xizor, and gives the express option to forfeit Guri to absorb remaining battle damage. The Force drain modifier names Coruscant sites. Other printed statistics, pilot/warrior icons and immunities remain.
